name: cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics API
summary: Public cancer genomics studies: mutations, copy number, expression and clinical data for hundreds of studies via a REST API.
description: The public cBioPortal instance serves a REST API behind the web UI, with endpoints for studies, cancer types, samples, patients, genes, molecular profiles, mutations and clinical data. A swagger/OpenAPI 3.1 spec is published. Unauthenticated access works for the public studies hosted on www.cbioportal.org.

auth.notes: Public studies need no token; private portals use data access tokens.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented; the docs ask heavy users to run their own instance.

endpoints.summary: Gene by Entrez id or symbol
Fetch mutations for a molecular profile and sample list (POST body)

license.name: Varies per study (public cancer studies; see study citations)

agent_notes: Start from /studies, then /studies/{id}/molecular-profiles and /samples. Bulk queries use POST /…/fetch endpoints with JSON bodies (see the OpenAPI spec). Use projection=SUMMARY|DETAILED|META to control detail and pageSize/pageNumber to page.
caveats: The OpenAPI spec title says "[Alpha]"; paths and fields may change.
Large mutation or expression pulls are heavy; prefer the fetch endpoints with explicit sample lists.
Study data licenses are not uniform; cite each study.
